panels.title: Неделя: выполнено и остаток фокуса · снимки и оценка

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE params AS (
 SELECT now() AS today,
 date_trunc('week',now()-interval '6 months') AS start_at
), audit AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb)
 AS a(item_id text,reason text,closed_at timestamptz)
), hierarchy_snapshot AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT content_id,parent_issue_id FROM analytics.items WHERE present AND snapshot->'content' ? 'parent'), hierarchy_edges AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT parent_issue_id AS parent_id,content_id AS child_id FROM hierarchy_snapshot WHERE parent_issue_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT e.parent_id,e.child_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb) AS e(parent_id text,child_id text) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hierarchy_snapshot known WHERE known.content_id=e.child_id)), focus_tree(issue_id) AS (
 SELECT i.snapshot->'content'->>'id' FROM analytics.items i JOIN analytics.item_fields h ON h.item_id=i.item_id AND h.field_id='horizon' WHERE i.present AND NOT i.archived AND i.snapshot->'content' ? 'parent' AND i.parent_issue_id IS NULL AND i.item_type IN ('ISSUE','DRAFT_ISSUE') AND h.value->>'optionId' IN ('focus','epics')
 UNION
 SELECT e.child_id FROM focus_tree f JOIN hierarchy_edges e ON e.parent_id=f.issue_id
), selected AS (
 SELECT i.item_id,i.item_type,ft.issue_id IS NOT NULL AS in_focus,i.snapshot->'content'->>'number' AS number,
 s.display_value AS status,i.snapshot->'content'->>'state' AS native_state,
 (i.snapshot->'content'->>'closedAt')::timestamptz AS closed_at,
 (i.snapshot->'content'->>'createdAt')::timestamptz AS created_at,
 CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.value->'number')='number' AND (e.value->>'number')::numeric>=0
 THEN (e.value->>'number')::numeric END AS points,
 it.start_date,it.duration_days,
 COALESCE(lower(i.state_reason) IN ('not_planned','duplicate'),false) AS cancelled
 FROM analytics.items i
 LEFT JOIN focus_tree ft ON ft.issue_id=i.snapshot->'content'->>'id'
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_fields s ON s.item_id=i.item_id AND s.field_name='Status'
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_fields e ON e.item_id=i.item_id AND e.field_id='points'
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_iterations it ON it.item_id=i.item_id AND it.field_name='Sprint'

 WHERE i.present AND NOT i.archived AND i.item_type='ISSUE'

), cohort AS (
 SELECT *,status='Done' AND (native_state='CLOSED' OR item_type='DRAFT_ISSUE') AS done,
 CASE WHEN status='Done' AND NOT cancelled AND (native_state='CLOSED' OR item_type='DRAFT_ISSUE') THEN
 CASE WHEN duration_days>0 AND closed_at>(start_date+duration_days)::timestamptz+interval '21 days' THEN (start_date+duration_days)::timestamptz
 WHEN closed_at>='2026-02-25'::timestamptz AND closed_at>=created_at AND closed_at<=now() THEN closed_at
 WHEN duration_days>0 AND (start_date+duration_days)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'<=now()
 THEN (start_date+duration_days)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' END END AS done_at
 FROM selected WHERE NOT cancelled
), summary AS (
 SELECT count(*) AS total,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(done,false)) AS open_count,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(done,false) AND points IS NULL) AS open_unknown,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(done,false)),0) AS remaining,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done AND done_at IS NOT NULL),0) AS completed,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done AND points IS NULL) AS done_unknown,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done AND done_at IS NULL) AS done_undated,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done AND done_at IS NULL),0) AS done_undated_points,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=p.start_at AND points IS NOT NULL) AS dated_completed,
 count(DISTINCT done_at::date) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=p.start_at AND points>0) AS completion_days,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done_at IS NOT NULL AND done_at=closed_at) AS github_dates,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done_at IS NOT NULL AND done_at IS DISTINCT FROM closed_at) AS estimated_dates,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM selected WHERE cancelled) AS excluded_cancelled
 FROM cohort CROSS JOIN params p
), source_dates AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb) AS a(item_id text,source_day date,kind text)
), confirmed_drafts AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb) AS d(item_id text,draft_created timestamptz,issue_created timestamptz)), arrival_candidates_focus AS (
 SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN s.source_day IS NOT NULL THEN s.source_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
 WHEN d.draft_created IS NOT NULL THEN d.draft_created
 WHEN c.created_at>='2026-02-25'::timestamptz THEN c.created_at END AS known_arrival
 FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN source_dates s USING(item_id) LEFT JOIN confirmed_drafts d ON d.item_id=c.item_id AND d.issue_created=c.created_at AND d.draft_created<=d.issue_created
 WHERE NOT COALESCE(c.done,false) OR c.done_at IS NOT NULL
), dated AS (
 SELECT a.*,COALESCE(least(known_arrival,done_at),p.start_at-interval '1 day') AS arrival_at,
 known_arrival IS NULL AS unknown_arrival
 FROM arrival_candidates_focus a CROSS JOIN params p
), weeks AS (
 SELECT w AS starts_at,least(w+interval '7 days',p.today) AS time
 FROM params p CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(p.start_at,date_trunc('week',p.today),interval '7 days')w
), weekly AS (
 SELECT w.starts_at,w.time,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=w.starts_at AND done_at<w.time AND in_focus),0)::double precision AS focus_done,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=w.starts_at AND done_at<w.time AND NOT in_focus),0)::double precision AS outside_done,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at<w.time AND (NOT COALESCE(done,false) OR done_at>=w.time)),0)::double precision AS remaining,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at>=w.starts_at AND arrival_at<w.time AND (NOT COALESCE(done,false) OR done_at>=w.time)),0)::double precision AS new_remaining,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at>=w.starts_at AND arrival_at<w.time),0)::double precision AS added,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at>=w.starts_at AND arrival_at<w.time AND done_at>=w.starts_at AND done_at<w.time),0)::double precision AS added_and_done
 FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN dated ON true GROUP BY w.starts_at,w.time
), obs_baseline AS (
 SELECT min(h.observed_at) AS starts_at
 FROM analytics.item_history h JOIN analytics.sync_runs r ON r.id=h.run_id AND r.status='complete'
 WHERE h.snapshot->>'type'='ISSUE' AND h.snapshot->'content' ? 'parent' AND h.snapshot->'content' ? 'stateReason'
), obs_cuts AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT w.time AS cutoff FROM weeks w
 UNION SELECT DISTINCT w.starts_at FROM weeks w
), obs_runs AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.cutoff,r.id,r.observed_at,r.started_at AS anchor_started_at
 FROM obs_cuts c CROSS JOIN obs_baseline b
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id,started_at,observed_at FROM analytics.sync_runs
 WHERE status='complete' AND observed_at<=c.cutoff AND observed_at>=b.starts_at
 ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1)r ON true
), obs_versions AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT r.cutoff,r.observed_at AS asof_at,h.*
 FROM obs_runs r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (h.item_id) h.item_id,h.snapshot,h.kind
 FROM analytics.item_history h JOIN analytics.sync_runs s ON s.id=h.run_id AND s.status='complete'
 WHERE h.observed_at<=r.observed_at ORDER BY h.item_id,h.observed_at DESC,h.revision DESC
 )h WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL
), obs_snapshot_items AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT v.*,jsonb_build_object(
 'horizon',hz->>'optionId','status',st->>'name','points',CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pt->'number')='number' AND (pt->>'number')::numeric>=0 THEN (pt->>'number')::numeric END,
 'state',upper(snapshot->'content'->>'state'),'reason',lower(snapshot->'content'->>'stateReason'),
 'parent',snapshot->'content'->'parent'->>'id','present',kind='observed','archived',(snapshot->>'isArchived')::boolean,'content_type','Issue'
 ) AS base_values,snapshot->'content'->>'id' AS issue_id,snapshot->'content'->'parent'->>'id' AS parent_id,
 COALESCE((snapshot->>'isArchived')::boolean,false) AS archived,
 snapshot->'content' ? 'parent' AND snapshot->'content' ? 'stateReason' AS keys_known,
 COALESCE(lower(snapshot->'content'->>'stateReason') IN ('not_planned','duplicate'),false) AS cancelled,
 COALESCE(snapshot->'content'->>'state'='CLOSED' AND st->>'name'='Done',false) AS done,
 hz->>'optionId' IN ('focus','epics') AS direct_focus,
 CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pt->'number')='number' AND (pt->>'number')::numeric>=0 THEN (pt->>'number')::numeric END AS points
 FROM obs_versions v
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f AS st FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'fields')f WHERE f->'field'->>'name'='Status' LIMIT 1)s ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f AS hz FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'fields')f WHERE f->'field'->>'id'='horizon' LIMIT 1)h ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f AS pt FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'fields')f WHERE f->'field'->>'id'='points' LIMIT 1)p ON true
 WHERE kind='observed' AND snapshot->>'type'='ISSUE'
), ev_window AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT r.cutoff,r.observed_at,r.anchor_started_at,e.*
 FROM obs_runs r JOIN analytics.project_events e
 ON e.received_at>r.anchor_started_at AND e.received_at<=r.cutoff
 AND e.project_id=(SELECT project_id FROM analytics.source_identity)
 WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL
), ev_known AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.*,i.item_id AS anchor_item_id,i.snapshot,i.base_values
 FROM ev_window e JOIN obs_snapshot_items i
 ON i.cutoff=e.cutoff AND i.issue_id=e.content_id
 WHERE e.event_name<>'projects_v2_item' OR e.item_id=i.item_id
), ev_attributes AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT e.cutoff,e.content_id,e.revision,e.received_at,e.source_updated_at,
 a.attribute,a.value,a.has_value,a.uncertain_clock,
 e.base_values->a.attribute AS base_value,
 CASE WHEN e.event_name='issues' THEN (e.snapshot->'content'->>'updatedAt')::timestamptz
 ELSE (e.snapshot->>'updatedAt')::timestamptz END AS anchor_source_time
 FROM ev_known e CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT CASE e.data->'field'->>'field_node_id'
 WHEN 'points' THEN 'points' WHEN 'horizon' THEN 'horizon' WHEN 'status' THEN 'status' END AS attribute,
 CASE WHEN e.data->'field' ? 'to' THEN CASE e.data->'field'->>'field_node_id'
 WHEN 'points' THEN e.data->'field'->'to'
 WHEN 'horizon' THEN COALESCE(e.data->'field'->'to'->'id','null'::jsonb)
 WHEN 'status' THEN COALESCE(e.data->'field'->'to'->'name','null'::jsonb) END END AS value,
 (e.data->'field' ? 'to') AND CASE e.data->'field'->>'field_node_id'
 WHEN 'points' THEN jsonb_typeof(e.data->'field'->'to') IN ('number','null')
 WHEN 'horizon' THEN jsonb_typeof(e.data->'field'->'to')='null' OR jsonb_typeof(e.data->'field'->'to'->'id')='string'
 WHEN 'status' THEN jsonb_typeof(e.data->'field'->'to')='null' OR jsonb_typeof(e.data->'field'->'to'->'name')='string' END AS has_value,false AS uncertain_clock
 WHERE e.event_name='projects_v2_item' AND e.action='edited'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT a.key,a.val,a.known,false FROM (VALUES
 ('state',to_jsonb(upper(e.data->>'state')),COALESCE(lower(e.data->>'state') IN ('open','closed'),false)),
 ('reason',to_jsonb(lower(e.data->>'state_reason')),e.data ? 'state_reason')
 )a(key,val,known) WHERE e.event_name='issues' AND e.action IN ('opened','closed','reopened','edited')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'parent',CASE WHEN (e.data->>'linked')::boolean THEN e.data->'parent_id' ELSE 'null'::jsonb END,
 CASE WHEN (e.data->>'linked')::boolean THEN jsonb_typeof(e.data->'parent_id')='string' ELSE true END,true
 WHERE e.event_name='sub_issues'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'present',e.data->'present',e.data ? 'present',true
 WHERE e.event_name='projects_v2_item' AND e.action IN ('created','deleted')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'archived',e.data->'archived',e.data ? 'archived',true
 WHERE e.event_name='projects_v2_item' AND e.action IN ('archived','restored')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'content_type',e.data->'content_type',e.data ? 'content_type',true
 WHERE e.event_name='projects_v2_item' AND e.action='converted'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'present',NULL::jsonb,false,true WHERE e.event_name='issues' AND e.action IN ('deleted','transferred')
 )a WHERE a.attribute IS NOT NULL
), ev_relevant AS MATERIALIZED (
 -- Older object observations do not override a newer full snapshot. Events
 -- without a reliable object clock still mark disagreement as unknown.
 SELECT *,COALESCE(value,'null'::jsonb) AS json_value
 FROM ev_attributes WHERE uncertain_clock OR source_updated_at IS NULL
 OR anchor_source_time IS NULL OR source_updated_at>=anchor_source_time
), ev_ranked AS (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY cutoff,content_id,attribute
 ORDER BY source_updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST,received_at DESC,revision DESC) AS position
 FROM ev_relevant
), ev_resolved AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.*,CASE
 WHEN c.uncertain_clock OR c.source_updated_at IS NULL OR c.anchor_source_time IS NULL
 THEN c.has_value AND c.json_value=c.base_value AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM ev_relevant other WHERE other.cutoff=c.cutoff AND other.content_id=c.content_id AND other.attribute=c.attribute
 AND (NOT other.has_value OR other.json_value IS DISTINCT FROM c.base_value))
 ELSE c.has_value
 AND (c.source_updated_at>c.anchor_source_time OR c.json_value=c.base_value)
 AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM ev_relevant other WHERE other.cutoff=c.cutoff AND other.content_id=c.content_id AND other.attribute=c.attribute
 AND (other.source_updated_at IS NULL OR (other.source_updated_at=c.source_updated_at
 AND (NOT other.has_value OR other.json_value IS DISTINCT FROM c.json_value))))
 END AS resolved
 FROM ev_ranked c WHERE position=1
), ev_patch AS (
 SELECT cutoff,content_id,
 jsonb_object_agg(attribute,CASE WHEN resolved THEN json_value ELSE 'null'::jsonb END) AS values,
 bool_and(COALESCE(resolved,false) OR attribute='points') AS structural_known,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(resolved,false)) AS unknown_attributes,
 max(received_at) AS last_received
 FROM ev_resolved GROUP BY cutoff,content_id
), obs_items AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.cutoff,i.asof_at,i.item_id,i.snapshot,i.kind,i.issue_id,
 m.vals->>'parent' AS parent_id,COALESCE((m.vals->>'archived')::boolean,false) AS archived,
 i.keys_known AND COALESCE(p.structural_known,true) AS keys_known,
 COALESCE(m.vals->>'reason' IN ('not_planned','duplicate'),false) AS cancelled,
 COALESCE(m.vals->>'state'='CLOSED' AND m.vals->>'status'='Done',false) AS done,
 m.vals->>'horizon' IN ('focus','epics') AS direct_focus,
 CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.vals->'points')='number' AND (m.vals->>'points')::numeric>=0
 THEN (m.vals->>'points')::numeric END AS points
 FROM obs_snapshot_items i LEFT JOIN ev_patch p ON p.cutoff=i.cutoff AND p.content_id=i.issue_id
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT i.base_values||COALESCE(p.values,'{}'::jsonb) AS vals)m
), ev_unanchored AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT e.cutoff,e.content_id
 FROM ev_window e WHERE NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM obs_snapshot_items i WHERE i.cutoff=e.cutoff AND i.issue_id=e.content_id)
 AND ((e.event_name='projects_v2_item' AND lower(e.data->>'content_type')='issue')
 OR (e.event_name='sub_issues' AND (e.data->>'linked')::boolean AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM obs_snapshot_items p WHERE p.cutoff=e.cutoff AND p.issue_id=e.data->>'parent_id')))
), ev_quality AS (
 SELECT r.cutoff,(SELECT count(*) FROM ev_unanchored u WHERE u.cutoff=r.cutoff) AS unanchored_issues,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT e.delivery_id) FROM ev_known e WHERE e.cutoff=r.cutoff) AS relevant_deliveries,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ev_resolved e WHERE e.cutoff=r.cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(e.resolved,false)) AS unknown_attributes,
 (SELECT max(e.received_at) FROM ev_known e WHERE e.cutoff=r.cutoff) AS last_event_received
 FROM obs_runs r
)
, obs_focus(cutoff,issue_id) AS (
 SELECT cutoff,issue_id FROM obs_items WHERE direct_focus AND NOT archived AND keys_known AND parent_id IS NULL
 UNION
 SELECT i.cutoff,i.issue_id FROM obs_focus f JOIN obs_items i ON i.cutoff=f.cutoff AND i.parent_id=f.issue_id
), obs_ancestors(cutoff,issue_id,ancestor_id) AS (
 SELECT cutoff,issue_id,parent_id FROM obs_items WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION
 SELECT a.cutoff,a.issue_id,p.parent_id FROM obs_ancestors a JOIN obs_items p ON p.cutoff=a.cutoff AND p.issue_id=a.ancestor_id WHERE p.parent_id IS NOT NULL
), obs_uncertain AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT a.cutoff,a.issue_id FROM obs_ancestors a
 LEFT JOIN obs_items p ON p.cutoff=a.cutoff AND p.issue_id=a.ancestor_id
 WHERE p.issue_id IS NULL OR a.issue_id=a.ancestor_id
), obs_members AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i.*,f.issue_id IS NOT NULL AS in_focus,u.issue_id IS NOT NULL AS uncertain_ancestry
 FROM obs_items i LEFT JOIN obs_focus f USING(cutoff,issue_id) LEFT JOIN obs_uncertain u USING(cutoff,issue_id)
), obs_totals AS (
 SELECT r.cutoff,r.observed_at,
 count(i.item_id) FILTER(WHERE NOT i.keys_known) AS missing_keys,
 count(i.item_id) FILTER(WHERE i.uncertain_ancestry AND NOT i.in_focus AND NOT i.archived AND NOT i.cancelled AND NOT i.done) AS uncertain_open,
 count(i.item_id) FILTER(WHERE i.in_focus AND NOT i.archived AND NOT i.cancelled AND NOT i.done AND i.points IS NULL) AS unknown_points,
 COALESCE(sum(i.points) FILTER(WHERE i.in_focus AND NOT i.archived AND NOT i.cancelled AND NOT i.done),0)::double precision AS remaining,
 count(i.item_id) AS issues
 FROM obs_runs r LEFT JOIN obs_members i USING(cutoff) GROUP BY r.cutoff,r.observed_at
), obs_valid AS (
 SELECT t.*,q.relevant_deliveries,q.unknown_attributes,q.last_event_received,q.unanchored_issues,observed_at IS NOT NULL AND cutoff-observed_at<=interval '2 hours' AND missing_keys=0 AND uncertain_open=0 AND issues>0 AND q.unanchored_issues=0 AS usable
 FROM obs_totals t JOIN ev_quality q USING(cutoff)
), obs_weekly AS (
 SELECT w.time,w.starts_at,e.observed_at,e.usable,e.remaining,e.unknown_points,
 COALESCE(s.usable AND s.unknown_points=0 AND e.unknown_points=0,false) AS start_usable,
 CASE WHEN e.usable AND s.usable AND s.unknown_points=0 AND e.unknown_points=0 THEN COALESCE((
 SELECT sum(greatest(i.points-CASE WHEN prior.in_focus AND NOT prior.archived AND NOT prior.cancelled AND NOT prior.done THEN prior.points ELSE 0 END,0)) FROM obs_members i
 LEFT JOIN obs_members prior ON prior.cutoff=w.starts_at AND prior.issue_id=i.issue_id
 WHERE i.cutoff=w.time AND i.in_focus AND NOT i.archived AND NOT i.cancelled AND NOT i.done
 ),0)::double precision END AS entered_remaining
 FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN obs_valid e ON e.cutoff=w.time LEFT JOIN obs_valid s ON s.cutoff=w.starts_at
)

 SELECT w.starts_at+interval '7 days' AS time,
 w.focus_done AS "Выполнено · нынешний фокус",
 w.outside_done AS "Выполнено · вне нынешнего фокуса",
 CASE WHEN b.starts_at IS NULL OR w.time<b.starts_at THEN w.remaining-w.new_remaining END AS "Остаток · реконструкция",
 CASE WHEN b.starts_at IS NULL OR w.time<b.starts_at THEN w.new_remaining END AS "Добавлено · реконструкция",
 CASE WHEN o.usable THEN o.remaining-COALESCE(o.entered_remaining,0) END AS "Остаток · снимки",
 CASE WHEN o.usable AND o.start_usable THEN o.entered_remaining END AS "Прирост · снимки",
 CASE WHEN o.usable THEN o.unknown_points END::double precision AS "Без оценки в фокусе · историй",
 CASE WHEN o.usable THEN extract(epoch FROM o.observed_at)*1000 END::double precision AS "Время снимка остатка · UTC",
 q.relevant_deliveries::double precision AS "Учтено доставок · после снимка",
 q.unknown_attributes::double precision AS "Неизвестных значений · события",
 q.unanchored_issues::double precision AS "Без исходного снимка · историй",
 (extract(epoch FROM q.last_event_received)*1000)::double precision AS "Получено событие · UTC"
 FROM weekly w CROSS JOIN obs_baseline b LEFT JOIN obs_weekly o USING(time) JOIN ev_quality q ON q.cutoff=w.time
 ORDER BY w.time;

WITH RECURSIVE params AS (
 SELECT now() AS today,
 date_trunc('week',now()-interval '6 months') AS start_at
), audit AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb)
 AS a(item_id text,reason text,closed_at timestamptz)
), hierarchy_snapshot AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT content_id,parent_issue_id FROM analytics.items WHERE present AND snapshot->'content' ? 'parent'), hierarchy_edges AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT parent_issue_id AS parent_id,content_id AS child_id FROM hierarchy_snapshot WHERE parent_issue_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT e.parent_id,e.child_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb) AS e(parent_id text,child_id text) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hierarchy_snapshot known WHERE known.content_id=e.child_id)), focus_tree(issue_id) AS (
 SELECT i.snapshot->'content'->>'id' FROM analytics.items i JOIN analytics.item_fields h ON h.item_id=i.item_id AND h.field_id='horizon' WHERE i.present AND NOT i.archived AND i.snapshot->'content' ? 'parent' AND i.parent_issue_id IS NULL AND i.item_type IN ('ISSUE','DRAFT_ISSUE') AND h.value->>'optionId' IN ('focus','epics')
 UNION
 SELECT e.child_id FROM focus_tree f JOIN hierarchy_edges e ON e.parent_id=f.issue_id
), selected AS (
 SELECT i.item_id,i.item_type,ft.issue_id IS NOT NULL AS in_focus,i.snapshot->'content'->>'number' AS number,
 s.display_value AS status,i.snapshot->'content'->>'state' AS native_state,
 (i.snapshot->'content'->>'closedAt')::timestamptz AS closed_at,
 (i.snapshot->'content'->>'createdAt')::timestamptz AS created_at,
 CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.value->'number')='number' AND (e.value->>'number')::numeric>=0
 THEN (e.value->>'number')::numeric END AS points,
 it.start_date,it.duration_days,
 COALESCE(lower(i.state_reason) IN ('not_planned','duplicate'),false) AS cancelled
 FROM analytics.items i
 LEFT JOIN focus_tree ft ON ft.issue_id=i.snapshot->'content'->>'id'
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_fields s ON s.item_id=i.item_id AND s.field_name='Status'
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_fields e ON e.item_id=i.item_id AND e.field_id='points'
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_iterations it ON it.item_id=i.item_id AND it.field_name='Sprint'

 WHERE i.present AND NOT i.archived AND i.item_type='ISSUE'

), cohort AS (
 SELECT *,status='Done' AND (native_state='CLOSED' OR item_type='DRAFT_ISSUE') AS done,
 CASE WHEN status='Done' AND NOT cancelled AND (native_state='CLOSED' OR item_type='DRAFT_ISSUE') THEN
 CASE WHEN duration_days>0 AND closed_at>(start_date+duration_days)::timestamptz+interval '21 days' THEN (start_date+duration_days)::timestamptz
 WHEN closed_at>='2026-02-25'::timestamptz AND closed_at>=created_at AND closed_at<=now() THEN closed_at
 WHEN duration_days>0 AND (start_date+duration_days)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'<=now()
 THEN (start_date+duration_days)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' END END AS done_at
 FROM selected WHERE NOT cancelled
), summary AS (
 SELECT count(*) AS total,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(done,false)) AS open_count,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(done,false) AND points IS NULL) AS open_unknown,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(done,false)),0) AS remaining,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done AND done_at IS NOT NULL),0) AS completed,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done AND points IS NULL) AS done_unknown,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done AND done_at IS NULL) AS done_undated,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done AND done_at IS NULL),0) AS done_undated_points,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=p.start_at AND points IS NOT NULL) AS dated_completed,
 count(DISTINCT done_at::date) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=p.start_at AND points>0) AS completion_days,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done_at IS NOT NULL AND done_at=closed_at) AS github_dates,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done_at IS NOT NULL AND done_at IS DISTINCT FROM closed_at) AS estimated_dates,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM selected WHERE cancelled) AS excluded_cancelled
 FROM cohort CROSS JOIN params p
), source_dates AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb) AS a(item_id text,source_day date,kind text)
), confirmed_drafts AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb) AS d(item_id text,draft_created timestamptz,issue_created timestamptz)), arrival_candidates_focus AS (
 SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN s.source_day IS NOT NULL THEN s.source_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
 WHEN d.draft_created IS NOT NULL THEN d.draft_created
 WHEN c.created_at>='2026-02-25'::timestamptz THEN c.created_at END AS known_arrival
 FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN source_dates s USING(item_id) LEFT JOIN confirmed_drafts d ON d.item_id=c.item_id AND d.issue_created=c.created_at AND d.draft_created<=d.issue_created
 WHERE NOT COALESCE(c.done,false) OR c.done_at IS NOT NULL
), dated AS (
 SELECT a.*,COALESCE(least(known_arrival,done_at),p.start_at-interval '1 day') AS arrival_at,
 known_arrival IS NULL AS unknown_arrival
 FROM arrival_candidates_focus a CROSS JOIN params p
), weeks AS (
 SELECT w AS starts_at,least(w+interval '7 days',p.today) AS time
 FROM params p CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(p.start_at,date_trunc('week',p.today),interval '7 days')w
), weekly AS (
 SELECT w.starts_at,w.time,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=w.starts_at AND done_at<w.time AND in_focus),0)::double precision AS focus_done,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=w.starts_at AND done_at<w.time AND NOT in_focus),0)::double precision AS outside_done,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at<w.time AND (NOT COALESCE(done,false) OR done_at>=w.time)),0)::double precision AS remaining,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at>=w.starts_at AND arrival_at<w.time AND (NOT COALESCE(done,false) OR done_at>=w.time)),0)::double precision AS new_remaining,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at>=w.starts_at AND arrival_at<w.time),0)::double precision AS added,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at>=w.starts_at AND arrival_at<w.time AND done_at>=w.starts_at AND done_at<w.time),0)::double precision AS added_and_done
 FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN dated ON true GROUP BY w.starts_at,w.time
), model AS (
 SELECT avg(focus_done+outside_done) FILTER(WHERE w.time<=date_trunc('week',p.today) AND w.time>date_trunc('week',p.today)-interval '12 weeks') AS mean_delivery,
 regr_slope(-remaining,extract(epoch FROM w.time)/604800) FILTER(WHERE w.time<=date_trunc('week',p.today) AND w.time>date_trunc('week',p.today)-interval '12 weeks') AS net_per_week,
 (SELECT remaining FROM weekly ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS remaining_now,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cohort WHERE in_focus AND NOT COALESCE(done,false) AND points IS NULL) AS open_unknown,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cohort WHERE in_focus AND done AND (points IS NULL OR done_at IS NULL)) AS completed_unknown
 FROM weekly w CROSS JOIN params p
), projection AS (
 SELECT m.*,CASE WHEN net_per_week>0.01 AND open_unknown=0 AND completed_unknown=0 AND remaining_now>0
 THEN p.today+(remaining_now/net_per_week)*interval '7 days' END AS crossing
 FROM model m CROSS JOIN params p
)
 SELECT time,mean_delivery::double precision AS "Среднее · 12 полных недель" FROM params CROSS JOIN projection CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(start_at),(today))v(time) ORDER BY time;

WITH RECURSIVE params AS (
 SELECT now() AS today,
 date_trunc('week',now()-interval '6 months') AS start_at
), audit AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb)
 AS a(item_id text,reason text,closed_at timestamptz)
), hierarchy_snapshot AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT content_id,parent_issue_id FROM analytics.items WHERE present AND snapshot->'content' ? 'parent'), hierarchy_edges AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT parent_issue_id AS parent_id,content_id AS child_id FROM hierarchy_snapshot WHERE parent_issue_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT e.parent_id,e.child_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb) AS e(parent_id text,child_id text) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hierarchy_snapshot known WHERE known.content_id=e.child_id)), focus_tree(issue_id) AS (
 SELECT i.snapshot->'content'->>'id' FROM analytics.items i JOIN analytics.item_fields h ON h.item_id=i.item_id AND h.field_id='horizon' WHERE i.present AND NOT i.archived AND i.snapshot->'content' ? 'parent' AND i.parent_issue_id IS NULL AND i.item_type IN ('ISSUE','DRAFT_ISSUE') AND h.value->>'optionId' IN ('focus','epics')
 UNION
 SELECT e.child_id FROM focus_tree f JOIN hierarchy_edges e ON e.parent_id=f.issue_id
), selected AS (
 SELECT i.item_id,i.item_type,ft.issue_id IS NOT NULL AS in_focus,i.snapshot->'content'->>'number' AS number,
 s.display_value AS status,i.snapshot->'content'->>'state' AS native_state,
 (i.snapshot->'content'->>'closedAt')::timestamptz AS closed_at,
 (i.snapshot->'content'->>'createdAt')::timestamptz AS created_at,
 CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.value->'number')='number' AND (e.value->>'number')::numeric>=0
 THEN (e.value->>'number')::numeric END AS points,
 it.start_date,it.duration_days,
 COALESCE(lower(i.state_reason) IN ('not_planned','duplicate'),false) AS cancelled
 FROM analytics.items i
 LEFT JOIN focus_tree ft ON ft.issue_id=i.snapshot->'content'->>'id'
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_fields s ON s.item_id=i.item_id AND s.field_name='Status'
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_fields e ON e.item_id=i.item_id AND e.field_id='points'
 LEFT JOIN analytics.item_iterations it ON it.item_id=i.item_id AND it.field_name='Sprint'

 WHERE i.present AND NOT i.archived AND i.item_type='ISSUE'

), cohort AS (
 SELECT *,status='Done' AND (native_state='CLOSED' OR item_type='DRAFT_ISSUE') AS done,
 CASE WHEN status='Done' AND NOT cancelled AND (native_state='CLOSED' OR item_type='DRAFT_ISSUE') THEN
 CASE WHEN duration_days>0 AND closed_at>(start_date+duration_days)::timestamptz+interval '21 days' THEN (start_date+duration_days)::timestamptz
 WHEN closed_at>='2026-02-25'::timestamptz AND closed_at>=created_at AND closed_at<=now() THEN closed_at
 WHEN duration_days>0 AND (start_date+duration_days)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'<=now()
 THEN (start_date+duration_days)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' END END AS done_at
 FROM selected WHERE NOT cancelled
), summary AS (
 SELECT count(*) AS total,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(done,false)) AS open_count,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(done,false) AND points IS NULL) AS open_unknown,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE NOT COALESCE(done,false)),0) AS remaining,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done AND done_at IS NOT NULL),0) AS completed,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done AND points IS NULL) AS done_unknown,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done AND done_at IS NULL) AS done_undated,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done AND done_at IS NULL),0) AS done_undated_points,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=p.start_at AND points IS NOT NULL) AS dated_completed,
 count(DISTINCT done_at::date) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=p.start_at AND points>0) AS completion_days,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done_at IS NOT NULL AND done_at=closed_at) AS github_dates,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE done_at IS NOT NULL AND done_at IS DISTINCT FROM closed_at) AS estimated_dates,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM selected WHERE cancelled) AS excluded_cancelled
 FROM cohort CROSS JOIN params p
), source_dates AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb) AS a(item_id text,source_day date,kind text)
), confirmed_drafts AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[]'::jsonb) AS d(item_id text,draft_created timestamptz,issue_created timestamptz)), arrival_candidates_focus AS (
 SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN s.source_day IS NOT NULL THEN s.source_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
 WHEN d.draft_created IS NOT NULL THEN d.draft_created
 WHEN c.created_at>='2026-02-25'::timestamptz THEN c.created_at END AS known_arrival
 FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN source_dates s USING(item_id) LEFT JOIN confirmed_drafts d ON d.item_id=c.item_id AND d.issue_created=c.created_at AND d.draft_created<=d.issue_created
 WHERE NOT COALESCE(c.done,false) OR c.done_at IS NOT NULL
), dated AS (
 SELECT a.*,COALESCE(least(known_arrival,done_at),p.start_at-interval '1 day') AS arrival_at,
 known_arrival IS NULL AS unknown_arrival
 FROM arrival_candidates_focus a CROSS JOIN params p
), weeks AS (
 SELECT w AS starts_at,least(w+interval '7 days',p.today) AS time
 FROM params p CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(p.start_at,date_trunc('week',p.today),interval '7 days')w
), weekly AS (
 SELECT w.starts_at,w.time,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=w.starts_at AND done_at<w.time AND in_focus),0)::double precision AS focus_done,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE done_at>=w.starts_at AND done_at<w.time AND NOT in_focus),0)::double precision AS outside_done,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at<w.time AND (NOT COALESCE(done,false) OR done_at>=w.time)),0)::double precision AS remaining,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at>=w.starts_at AND arrival_at<w.time AND (NOT COALESCE(done,false) OR done_at>=w.time)),0)::double precision AS new_remaining,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at>=w.starts_at AND arrival_at<w.time),0)::double precision AS added,
 COALESCE(sum(points) FILTER(WHERE in_focus AND arrival_at>=w.starts_at AND arrival_at<w.time AND done_at>=w.starts_at AND done_at<w.time),0)::double precision AS added_and_done
 FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN dated ON true GROUP BY w.starts_at,w.time
), model AS (
 SELECT avg(focus_done+outside_done) FILTER(WHERE w.time<=date_trunc('week',p.today) AND w.time>date_trunc('week',p.today)-interval '12 weeks') AS mean_delivery,
 regr_slope(-remaining,extract(epoch FROM w.time)/604800) FILTER(WHERE w.time<=date_trunc('week',p.today) AND w.time>date_trunc('week',p.today)-interval '12 weeks') AS net_per_week,
 (SELECT remaining FROM weekly ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS remaining_now,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cohort WHERE in_focus AND NOT COALESCE(done,false) AND points IS NULL) AS open_unknown,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cohort WHERE in_focus AND done AND (points IS NULL OR done_at IS NULL)) AS completed_unknown
 FROM weekly w CROSS JOIN params p
), projection AS (
 SELECT m.*,CASE WHEN net_per_week>0.01 AND open_unknown=0 AND completed_unknown=0 AND remaining_now>0
 THEN p.today+(remaining_now/net_per_week)*interval '7 days' END AS crossing
 FROM model m CROSS JOIN params p
)
 SELECT t AS time,least(0,-remaining_now+COALESCE(net_per_week,0)*extract(epoch FROM t-today)/604800)::double precision AS "Тренд · сценарий реконструкции" FROM params CROSS JOIN projection CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT generate_series(today,least(COALESCE(crossing,today+interval '6 months'),today+interval '6 months'),interval '7 days') AS t UNION SELECT least(COALESCE(crossing,today+interval '6 months'),today+interval '6 months'))v ORDER BY t;

panels.description: Фокус — корни в фокусном горизонте и их потомки. После начала наблюдений остаток считается по снимкам и полученным событиям. Если состав неясен или снимок устарел, точка пропускается.
